svg.title: From complexity to an energy account

cc:Work.dc:title: From complexity to an energy account
cc:Work.dc:description: Analytical complexity-to-energy accounting: declared assumptions produce workload counters, which are multiplied by illustrative energy prices. Module-isolated rows and a shared-system sum have different boundaries; a system sum requires a matched interval and one idle baseline. The schematic contains no numerical results or empirical calibration. Producer: tools/generate_graphical_abstracts.py; SHA-256: 5be3d1ac6eb422f2844d7e42f86c03030507e4fd6ccc4d516e1d11b29363c90b. Semantic source hashes and output inventory: graphical_abstracts.provenance.json.
